subject: Predict by detector covariate and session

messages.author: cab31ecf29fa17ff
messages.subject: Predict by detector covariate and session
parts:
Hi folks,

I have a secr.fit model with a detector covariate (2 treatments). Five session model output will give me estimates of D for my first covariate “Inside” and I can use predict to get one estimate of D for “Outside”. But how can I get one estimate for each session for my second covariate “Outside”.

Thanks,

Cheryl

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: Predict by detector covariate and session
parts:
Hi Cheryl
It probably helps to tighten up the terminology: you have one covariate Treatment with two levels 'Inside' and 'Outside'. In your case it should be enough to use
predict(fitted, all.levels = TRUE)
or more explicitly, for e.g. 5 sessions,
predict(fitted, newdata = expand.grid(session=1:5, Treatment = factor(c('Inside','Outside'))))
Murray
